bitcoin_articles.headline: Sphere 3D Shareholders Approve Business Combination with Cathedra Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sphere 3D Corp. announced that its shareholders have approved proposals related to its business combination with Cathedra Bitcoin Inc., including the issuance of common shares to Cathedra shareholders.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Tether Acquires SoftBank's Stake in Bitcoin Treasury Firm
bitcoin_articles.summary: Tether has completed a buyout of SoftBank's equity stake in a Bitcoin treasury-focused firm.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company Increases Bitcoin Holdings to 2,859 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company PLC announced the purchase of an additional 19 Bitcoin, bringing its total treasury holdings to 2,859 BTC.
